plainText:
Wakana Minami (Japanese: 美波わかな Minami Wakana) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Minami was born on March 1, 1994, in , , , and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the during , gaining several roles such as Piko and one of the members of Team Electric Princess. Her most notable role so far is that of Sandy, the protagonist of the Where Are You Going, Eevee? shorts who was later by . In addition to her work on , Minami has also worked on . Minami is currently affiliated with HiBiKi. Formerly associated with .. She used to go by her stage name Wakana Kingyo (Japanese: 金魚わかな Kingyo Wakana).
